tests.name: New two-frame coordinates rerun every inverse fit and produce new predictions and densities
Mapped selection is linked to the fresh nominal solve, with ambiguity and independent assessment retained
Common perturbations are regenerated deterministically around the changed observations
Invalid or incompatible new frames never fall back to a previous saved density
CommonJS exportSource produces a standalone module in an empty VM with no files or globals
Delivered single-file mapping artifact also executes fresh observations without external imports
Outer selection sensitivity reruns the whole selector and avoids an extra assessment/noise layer
Outer seeds and all failure denominators reproduce without implying model probabilities

scope: Software mapping and denominator checks only. The tiny outer test budget is not a research estimate or evidence of real physical model probabilities.
